en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, a state that is neither non-demonstrable nor non-reactive and is unwholesome arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a wholesome state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive,

a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and is unwholesome arises by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a wholesome state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive, [a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and is unwholesome arises].
Conditioned by a root, there arise states that are neither visible nor impinging and are neither wholesome nor unwholesome.
(Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] for the root; six for the predominance ... pe ... six for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is invisible, non-impinging, and unwholesome, there arises a state that is neither invisible nor non-impinging and is not unwholesome.
[It] arises by way of root condition. Dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive unwholesome state,
there arises a state that is neither manifesting nor reactive and is not unwholesome by way of root condition …pe… dependent on a non-manifesting, non-reactive unwholesome state,
there arise states that are neither manifesting nor reactive and are both not unwholesome and not non-manifesting, non-reactive.
They arise by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Six [conditions] for the root; six for the predominance …pe… six for non-disappearance.
Conditioned by a non-manifesting, non-reacting, indeterminate state, there arises a state that is neither manifesting nor reacting and is not indeterminate by way of the root condition.
Conditioned by a non-manifesting, non-reacting, indeterminate state, there arises a state that is neither non-manifesting nor reacting …pe… by way of the root condition.

A non-indeterminate state does not arise with a root condition. With a non-indeterminate state that is non-demonstrable and non-reactive as condition, states that are neither demonstrable-and-reactive nor non-indeterminate, and states that are neither non-demonstrable-and-reactive nor non-indeterminate, arise with a root condition...
Under root [condition], three... pe... under non-disappearance [condition], three.
